county_comprehensive_plans.limits: A citation list for large counties only; each county's own page is the authority.

ntm_stops.name: National Transit Map, stops
ntm_stops.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics
ntm_stops.vintage: National Transportation Atlas Database release compiled 2026-09-23
ntm_stops.limits: Stops as reported by agencies in their schedule feeds; some agencies are missing or out of date. Gives stop locations, not service frequency (frequency comes from the agency schedule feeds). About 673,000 stops nationally; queried by state bounding box in pages of at most 2,000.

tiger_2020_tabblock.name: TIGER/Line 2020 tabulation blocks (attribute table only)
tiger_2020_tabblock.limits: Housing units and population are 2020 counts, not current. Internal points are a point inside each block, not its centre of population. Only the attribute table (the .dbf, about 46 MB of the 409 MB Pennsylvania zip) is read, by HTTP range requests; block shapes are never downloaded.

cb_2020_tract.name: Cartographic boundary file, census tracts, 2020, 1:500,000
cb_2020_tract.limits: Generalized (simplified) shapes for maps, not for measuring land area or for parcel work. 2020 tracts match the 2020-2024 ACS.

gtfs_agency_feeds.name: Transit agency schedule feeds (GTFS), via their published addresses or the catalog mirror
gtfs_agency_feeds.publisher: Each transit agency (copies mirrored by MobilityData)
gtfs_agency_feeds.vintage: The schedule current when fetched; the representative date is recorded per feed
gtfs_agency_feeds.limits: Scheduled, not actual, service. One representative weekday per feed. Only feeds that download without a key are used; bus stops of other agencies are marked frequency unknown. Agencies change stop ids between schedules, so a few stops may not match the National Transit Map.

freddie_pmms.name: Primary Mortgage Market Survey, weekly rate history
freddie_pmms.limits: National average offered rates for prime borrowers, not the rate a given household or builder pays. The value used in the model is a ledger parameter with a range.

bls_qcew_construction.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, annual averages, construction (NAICS 23)
bls_qcew_construction.limits: Average pay of construction jobs at private employers, by where the employer reports, not where it builds. A wage index is a proxy for local building costs; materials, land and fees are not in it. BLS withholds county figures that would reveal one employer; those counties take the state value.
